experiments.research_question: Can the Research Lab execute a bounded allowlisted deterministic experiment and preserve auditable evidence?
experiments.decision: Whether the GitHub command-bus plumbing is safe enough to proceed to a post-merge end-to-end proof.
experiments.hypothesis: A tracked synthetic fixture produces identical deterministic digests across bounded repeats while a deliberate negative control produces a different digest.

controls.positive: Repeated hashing of the exact frozen fixture must remain identical.
controls.negative: Hashing the fixture with a fixed mutation marker must differ from the frozen fixture digest.

experiments.scoring: All repeats must equal the frozen fixture SHA-256 and every fixed negative-control digest must differ.
experiments.success_gate: positive_matches == repeat AND negative_distinct == repeat AND invalid_cases == 0
experiments.stop_condition: Stop after the requested bounded repeat count; never retry or tune.
